about: Every Swedish Trafikverket station (signature) and the Statistics Sweden statistical urban area (tätort) it stands in, with its population: the hub rule for the look (Lee 2026-11-08, Intercity SSOT 8.9 decision 6: Stockholm C, else the trip's larger end city). Placed by point in polygon; a station outside every tätort takes the nearest within 1,500 m (off_m), else none (population null; the trip's other end decides).
licence: SCB open data, CC0 1.0 (scb.se, open data terms); Trafikverket CC0 1.0
source: Statistics Sweden (SCB): Statistiska tätorter 2023 (open geodata, WFS stat:Tatorter_2023, bef), names by tätort code from table MI0810 LandarealTatortN; Trafikverket TrainStation (CC0)
